requirements.quote: `spectracut setup --storage-host <registered windows host>` produces the admin script, then mounts and maps the share once it has run [type:e2e]
A host marked gpu-only gets no build lanes and its RAM cap is enforced in its computeshare allowance [type:unit]
Every command in manifest.yaml exists in a shipped package or image (a test resolves them) [type:unit]
Audio tools install from the #48 image [type:e2e]

On Windows, creating the share needs admin, so setup prints (or serves over Tailscale) a one-time admin script like the one used for mrdubey (dedicated hidden `flamenco` account, Tailscale-only firewall rule, password handed to the SSH account through an ACL'd file), then mounts it on the control plane with CIFS and maps it on every worker.
A per-host role `gpu-only` with a RAM cap (the owner's main PC: GPU work only, at most 4 GB RAM, no build lanes).
use the pinned Debian image proven in #48 (`host/docker/audio.Dockerfile`) instead of distro packages.
install from the scripts and picks of #49 and from Poly Haven / ambientCG APIs, or drop those components until their CLIs exist; never reference a command that isn't shipped.

deliverables.change: New one-time admin script: param -Share -PasswordFile -User flamenco; creates hidden local account (password read from file, file deleted after), SMB share on C:/spectracut/storage, Tailscale-only (100.64.0.0/10) firewall rule; idempotent.

For a Windows storage host replace the remote admin step in _serve_steps with: write windows_storage.ps1 and an ACL'd password file to the host (stdin for secrets), print the admin command, and a check step that fails with an actionable StorageError/SetupError until the share exists (non-admin probe, e.g. `net view \\localhost` / Test-Path \\server\flamenco); once present, existing attach steps (CIFS on control, map on workers) run. Re-run is idempotent. Linux/NAS paths unchanged.
Thread the new storage steps/notes (admin-script path note) through build_plan; skip build-oriented roles for gpu-only hosts if applicable; load worker_script-style source for windows_storage.ps1.
Print the admin-script instructions and exit non-zero-with-message until it has run; help text for --storage-host.
HostEntry gains role (general|gpu-only, default general) and ram_cap_gb (gpu-only defaults to 4, must be >0); `hosts add --role --ram-cap-gb`; HostEntry.slot() applies the cap.

HostSlot gains build_lanes: bool=True; HostPoolExecutor never places build-lane jobs on build_lanes=False hosts; add pure computeshare_allowance(slot) -> dict with mem_gb capped and build_lanes false for gpu-only.

Remove local-models, polyhaven-assets, ambientcg-assets, addons, audio-plugins, ardour, supercollider (and their set pins); add one control-role component `audio-image` that builds host/docker/audio.Dockerfile with docker (tag pinned to the set version) and version_cmd via `docker image inspect`. Every remaining command must be a shipped console script or a system tool.

New: windows storage host yields script+password-file steps and a blocking check until the share exists, then mount/map steps; no password on command lines; gpu-only host has build_lanes false and allowance mem<=4GB; migrate/idempotence unaffected.

Update EXPECTED components; add test that resolves the first command token of every install/version_cmd to a [project.scripts] entry, a whitelisted system tool (curl, tar, sh, docker, uv, blender, smbd, ...) or the audio image, and that the audio-image step references host/docker/audio.Dockerfile.
Adjust existing tests for removed components and the new Windows storage flow if they break.
Add test that HostPoolExecutor refuses build-lane work on a gpu-only slot (or put in test_storage.py if hostpool tests live elsewhere).

preserve.what: Windows paths in Flamenco variables use forward slashes (storage.py to_flamenco_path / storage_variables)
Secrets travel on stdin only, never on command lines (tests/setup/test_plan.py::test_secrets_stay_off_command_lines)
Linux storage host and nas:// flows, migrate-on-change and idempotent re-run (plan_storage returns [] when previous == target)
Existing hosts.json files without role/ram_cap_gb still load (src/spectracut/cli/render.py HostRegistry)
Blender never installed on the control plane; spectracut-host/uv/blender/flamenco components unchanged (src/spectracut/setup/manifest.yaml)

validate.command: uv run --frozen pytest -q tests/setup/test_storage.py tests/setup/test_manifest.py tests/setup/test_plan.py
uv run --frozen pytest -q tests/queue tests/cli/test_cli.py -k 'host or gpu or role'

decisions.choice: Admin-script handoff with a re-run gate rather than remote elevation
decisions.justification: Workers are non-admin per-user tasks (src/spectracut/setup/windows_worker.ps1:1-3, #121); issue text requires printing/serving a one-time admin script.

decisions.choice: Drop the #49 model/asset/addon components rather than implement CLIs
decisions.justification: Issue allows 'drop those components until their CLIs exist'; #49 is still open.

decisions.choice: computeshare allowance modelled as a pure function in the host pool, since computeshare is external to this repo
decisions.justification: No computeshare code in repo (grep); docs/engineering/technical-spike.md:635 describes it as an optional integration.
